extraction.name: DocVQA
extraction.description: DocVQA is a dataset for Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images consisting of 50,000 questions defined over 12,767 document images sourced from the UCSF Industry Documents Library.
extraction.creator: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C.V. Jawahar
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Documents were downloaded from different industry collections within the UCSF Industry Documents Library. Pages were hand-picked to minimize binarized images and prioritize pages containing tables, forms, lists, and figures over running text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Document pages sourced from 6,071 industry documents spanning 1900 to 2018 across five major industries (tobacco, food, drug, fossil fuel, and chemical) from the UCSF Industry Documents Library.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were selected to prioritize non-binarized quality and structural variety. For reading comprehension models, OCR tokens extracted by a commercial OCR engine were serialized into a single string separated by space in top-left to bottom-right order.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations were gathered in three stages: In stage 1, remote workers formulated up to 10 question-answer pairs per image with answers verbatim from the text. In stage 2, another worker answered the questions independently without seeing stage 1 answers, assigned question types, and could flag invalid/ambiguous questions for removal. In stage 3, questions with mismatched answers were reviewed and accepted, edited, or discarded by the authors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Verification of answers across multiple annotators: if none of the answers from stage 1 matched stage 2 answers exactly, the pair underwent manual review and adjudication by the authors.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Up to 10 question-answer pairs per document image in stage 1, independently answered by a second worker in stage 2.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Remote workers supported by Amazon for crowdsourced annotation stages, institutional volunteers for human evaluation, and paper authors for review.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Frequent question bias toward common document elements (dates, titles, totals, page numbers); predominance of numeric answers and documents concentrated between 1960–2000; high representation of food and nutrition collections due to image quality selection.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Extractive question answering formulation relies on verbatim text present in document images; model performance is vulnerable to OCR errors and underperforms on figures, diagrams, layout understanding, and handwritten text.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, validation, testing, and benchmarking of Document Visual Question Answering and multimodal reading comprehension models.
